args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the fixed version.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337`.

## Reviewers

- @alex

trace.final:

1. **Investigated the advisory**: CVE-2026-31337 (high severity) affects fastjson `<2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0` — unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Fixed in `2.9.4` (and `3.1.0`).

2. **Created a branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded the pin** in `requirements.txt` from `fastjson==2.8.0` to `fastjson==2.9.4` and committed it.

4. **Ran CI** (run `ci-0001`) on the branch — it **passed**.

5. **Opened a pull request** [#101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", requesting review from **alex**.

The PR is open and awaiting review; I did not merge it since merging into main requires code-owner approval.
